title: 第二十章 血涧
content_zh:
柴刀的锋刃，在幽暗瘴气中，倒映着王炎狰狞的脸，和陈默自己那双深不见底、仿佛凝固了的眼睛。

    没有呼喝，没有试探。王炎的恨意与杀心，已膨胀到无需任何言语来装饰。他右腿膝盖血流如注，每踏前一步，都拖出一道暗红的血痕，脸上因剧痛和暴怒而扭曲，但那双盯着陈默的眼睛，却亮得骇人，如同即将择人而噬的、受了伤的凶兽。他手中那柄泛着微光的短剑，剑尖吞吐着尺许长的、不稳定的暗红色厉芒，那是火云掌的掌力被强行灌注于剑锋的结果，灼热、暴戾，带着火毒特有的燥烈气息，将周围阴湿的瘴气都蒸腾得微微扭曲。

    陈默握着柴刀，右肩后背的伤口火辣辣地疼，每一次呼吸都牵扯着胸腹间的旧伤。但他站得很稳，双脚微微分开，重心下沉，是无数次砍柴、站桩后，身体最本能的战斗姿态。柴刀斜指地面，刀身上沾着的泥污和之前赵明剑锋带出的血，在幽暗光线下呈现出一种污浊的暗红色。体内那缕暖流，在生死压迫下，以前所未有的速度疯狂运转，冲刷着滞涩的经脉，带来撕裂般的痛楚，却也带来一股近乎麻木的、沸腾的力量感，让他勉强压制住因失血和恐惧而生的眩晕。

    王炎动了。

    他没有像在较技台上那样猛扑，而是拖着伤腿，以一种怪异却迅捷的侧滑步，瞬间拉近距离！右腿的剧痛似乎被他强行压下，身法竟比想象中更快！短剑带着暗红厉芒，直刺陈默心口，毫无花哨，只有赤裸裸的、凝聚了炼气四层巅峰全部灵力的必杀之意！剑锋未至，那股灼热锋锐的气息已刺激得陈默胸口皮肤刺痛，呼吸为之一窒。

    躲不开！以他现在的状态和速度，根本无法完全避开这凝聚了王炎所有恨意与修为的一剑！

    陈默瞳孔缩成针尖，在短剑及体的前一刻，他做了一件与面对赵明那一剑时类似、却更为决绝的事——他没有试图完全闪避，甚至没有用柴刀去格挡那明显蕴含了火云掌力的剑锋。他左脚猛地向前踏出，不是迎向剑尖，而是斜斜踏向王炎受伤右腿的支撑侧！同时，上半身竭尽全力地向右侧拧转、后仰！

    “嗤——！”

    短剑带着灼热的厉芒，擦着陈默左胸肋骨掠过！锋锐的剑气瞬间撕裂了本就破烂的衣衫，在他左胸至腋下，划开一道深可见骨、皮肉焦糊翻卷的可怕伤口！火毒掌力顺势侵入，如同烧红的烙铁狠狠按在骨头上！

    “呃啊——！”难以言喻的剧痛让陈默眼前一黑，差点昏厥过去。但他咬碎了舌尖，血腥气和剧烈的疼痛反而让他精神猛地一振！他拧转后仰的身体并未停止，借着这股拧转之力，早已蓄势待发的右臂，连同手中沉重的柴刀，化作一道模糊的黑影，用尽全身残存的力量，以刀背，狠狠横扫向王炎那条作为支撑、此刻因刺击而微微前伸、又受了膝伤、灵活性大减的右腿脚踝！

    “咔嚓！”

    清脆的骨裂声，在寂静的林间空地中，显得格外刺耳！王炎发出一声凄厉得不似人声的惨嚎，整个人失去平衡，向前扑倒！他刺出的短剑也因身体失衡而偏斜，深深刺入了陈默身旁的湿软泥地中，暗红厉芒骤然熄灭大半。

    但陈默也付出了惨重代价。左胸那道伤口血流如注，火毒掌力在体内疯狂肆虐，灼烧着他的经脉和内脏，剧痛几乎让他失去意识。他踉跄着后退，柴刀拄地，才勉强没有倒下，口中鲜血狂喷，视线开始模糊、旋转。

    “小杂种……我要你死！要你死！！”王炎扑倒在地，右腿脚踝以一个诡异的角度扭曲着，显然断了。但他竟然用左手撑地，拖着两条几乎废掉的腿，面目狰狞如恶鬼，右手重新抓起短剑，不顾一切地向着近在咫尺、摇摇欲坠的陈默爬来，短剑胡乱地刺向陈默的下身！状若疯狂！

    陈默视线模糊，只看到一团黑影和一点暗红光芒向自己滚来。他想挥刀，但左胸的剧痛和失血带来的虚弱，让他的手臂沉重如铅，抬起柴刀都变得无比艰难。他只能勉强向侧后方退了一步，脚下却被一根裸露的树根绊住，身体失去平衡，向后仰倒！

    眼看王炎那胡乱刺来的短剑，就要刺入他的小腹！

    “嗡——！”

    就在这千钧一发之际，那熟悉的、轻微的琴弦震颤声再次响起！数道肉眼几乎难以捕捉的银光，如同拥有生命般，精准地射向正在地上疯狂爬行、毫无防备的王炎！不是射向他持剑的手，而是射向他脖颈、面门等要害！

    王炎虽陷入疯狂，但生死关头依旧有本能反应。他猛地一偏头，左手下意识地抬起格挡。

    “噗噗噗！”

    三枚银针，两枚射入他抬起的左臂，一枚擦着他的脖颈飞过，留下一道血痕。左臂中针处，瞬间传来剧烈的麻痹感，仿佛整条手臂都不是自己的了，抬都抬不起来。他爬行的动作也为之一滞。

    是苏芸！她在与赵明、李贺的缠斗中，竟然还能分心，发出这救命的数针！

    但这分心，也让她付出了代价。

    “贱人！找死！”赵明抓住苏芸分神发针的瞬间，不顾手臂酸麻，长剑带着一股狠劲，不顾自身空门，直刺苏芸咽喉！完全是两败俱伤的打法！旁边的李贺也趁机一剑削向苏芸腰肋！

    苏芸身形急退，如同风中飘絮，险之又险地避开了咽喉要害，但腰侧的衣衫却被李贺的剑锋划开一道口子，隐约有血迹渗出。她脸色更白了一分，但眼神依旧冰冷，指尖银光再闪，逼得赵明、李贺不得不回剑自保，不敢过分紧逼。但她显然也被牵制住，无暇再顾陈默这边。

    这短暂的阻滞，对陈默而言，已是救命稻草。他强忍着左胸火烧火燎的剧痛和失血带来的眩晕，趁着王炎左臂麻痹、动作停滞的瞬间，右手猛地在地上一撑，身体向旁边翻滚，险险避开了王炎那失去准头、刺入泥地的短剑。翻滚中，他摸到了自己掉落的柴刀，毫不犹豫地，用尽最后力气，将柴刀向着王炎的方向，狠狠掷了出去！

    不是砍，不是刺，而是如同投掷标枪一般，将柴刀当作一根沉重的铁棍，砸向王炎！

    王炎左臂麻痹，右腿脚踝断裂，左腿膝弯重伤，行动极为不便。眼看柴刀带着呼啸的风声砸来，他只来得及勉强将头一偏。

    “砰！”

    柴刀的刀背，重重砸在王炎的右侧太阳穴上！沉闷的撞击声，让人牙酸。王炎脑袋猛地一歪，双目瞬间失神，口中溢出鲜血和白沫，整个人僵直了一瞬，随即软软地扑倒在地，手中的短剑“哐当”落地，再无声息。只有身体还在无意识地微微抽搐。

    陈默一击得手，也耗尽了最后一丝气力，瘫倒在地，眼前阵阵发黑，耳中嗡鸣不止，只有左胸伤口那撕心裂肺的痛楚，和体内火毒肆虐带来的灼热感，无比清晰地告诉他，他还活着，但也离死不远了。

    另一边，苏芸与赵明、李贺的战团，也因为这边的剧变而出现了刹那的凝滞。

    赵明和李贺难以置信地看着扑倒在地、生死不知的王炎，又看看远处瘫倒、血流不止的陈默，最后看向面色苍白、却依然指尖银光闪烁、冷冷注视着他们的苏芸，脸上终于露出了恐惧。

    王炎，炼气四层巅峰，外门新弟子中的佼佼者，竟然……被一个重伤的杂役，用这种近乎同归于尽的方式，打倒了？虽然那杂役看起来也离死不远，但这结果，依然让他们难以接受，更感到一股寒意自心底升起。

    这苏芸，身法诡异，暗器歹毒。这陈默，悍不畏死，手段狠绝。这两人……

    “赵、赵师兄……王师兄他……”李贺声音发颤，握剑的手都在抖。

    赵明脸色变幻不定，眼中恐惧、不甘、贪婪、犹豫交织。王炎倒了，洞里的“机缘”似乎唾手可得，但苏芸还在，那杂役不知死没死透，而且此地不宜久留……他猛地一咬牙，厉声道：“走！先离开这里！”

    他看都不看地上生死不知的王炎，转身就向着来路狂奔！李贺如蒙大赦，也急忙跟上，两人身影很快消失在密林瘴气之中，连回头看一眼的勇气都没有。

    苏芸并未追击。她站在原地，微微喘息，看着赵明二人消失的方向，又低头看了看自己腰侧渗血的伤口，眉头几不可察地蹙了一下。然后，她转身，快步走向陈默。

    陈默躺在地上，视线模糊，只能看到一道白色的、有些晃动的身影向他靠近。他试图抬起手，却连一根手指都动不了。喉咙里发出嗬嗬的声响，想说什么，却只有血沫不断涌出。
content_en:
The blade of the hatchet reflected Wang Yan's ferocious face and Chen Mo's own bottomless eyes in the dark miasma.
There is no shouting, no temptation.Wang Yan's hatred and murderous intentions have expanded to the point that no words are needed to decorate them.His right knee was bleeding profusely, and with every step he took, a dark red blood trail appeared. His face was distorted by severe pain and rage, but the eyes staring at Chen Mo were frighteningly bright, like a wounded beast about to devour someone.The shimmering dagger in his hand had a long, unstable dark red light about a foot long coming from the tip. It was the result of the palm power of the Fire Cloud Palm being forcibly poured into the sword's edge. It was hot, violent, and had the unique aura of fire poison, making the surrounding damp miasma evaporate and twist slightly.
Chen Mo held the hatchet in his hand. The wound on his right shoulder and back was burning. Every breath pulled at the old wound in his chest and abdomen.But he stood very steadily, with his feet slightly apart and his center of gravity lowered. This was the most instinctive fighting posture of his body after countless times of chopping wood and standing at the stake.The hatchet pointed diagonally at the ground. The dirt on the blade and the blood brought out by Zhao Ming's sword showed a dirty dark red color in the dim light.The warm current in his body, under the pressure of life and death, was running crazily at an unprecedented speed, washing away the stagnant meridians, bringing tearing pain, but it also brought an almost numb and boiling sense of strength, allowing him to barely suppress the dizziness caused by blood loss and fear.
Wang Yan moved.
He didn't pounce like he did on the competition stage. Instead, he dragged his injured leg and used a weird but quick side sliding step to instantly close the distance!The severe pain in his right leg seemed to be suppressed by him, and his movement was faster than expected!The dagger had a dark red light and pierced Chen Mo's heart. There was nothing flashy about it, only the naked will to kill that condensed all the spiritual power at the peak of the fourth level of Qi Refining!Before the blade of the sword arrived, the hot and sharp breath had already stimulated the skin on Chen Mo's chest to tingle, and his breathing was suffocated.
Can't escape!With his current state and speed, there is no way he can completely avoid this sword that condenses all of Wang Yan's hatred and cultivation!
Chen Mo's pupils shrank to pinpoints. The moment before the dagger reached his body, he did something similar but more decisive than when he faced Zhao Ming's sword - he did not try to dodge completely, or even use a hatchet to block the sword edge, which clearly contained the power of Huoyun's palm.He suddenly stepped forward with his left foot, not toward the tip of the sword, but diagonally toward the supporting side of Wang Yan's injured right leg!At the same time, try your best to twist your upper body to the right and lean back!
"laugh--!"
The dagger carried a scorching light, grazing Chen Mo's left chest and ribs!The sharp sword energy tore through his already tattered clothes in an instant, and opened a terrible wound from his left chest to his armpit, with bones visible and the flesh scorched and rolled!The power of the fire poison palm invaded smoothly, like a red-hot iron pressing hard on the bones!
"Uh ah——!" The indescribable severe pain made Chen Mo's eyes darken and he almost fainted.But he bit the tip of his tongue, and the smell of blood and severe pain made him feel refreshed!He twisted and leaned back without stopping. With the force of this twist, his right arm, which had been ready for action, together with the heavy hatchet in his hand, turned into a blurry black shadow. He used all the remaining strength in his body to use the back of the knife to swipe hard at Wang Yan's right leg and ankle, which was used as a support and was slightly stretched forward due to the stabbing. He also suffered a knee injury and his flexibility was greatly reduced!
"Crack!"
The crisp sound of bone cracking was particularly harsh in the silent forest glade!Wang Yan let out a howl that was so shrill that it didn't sound like a human voice. He lost his balance and fell forward!The dagger he thrust out was also deflected due to his body's imbalance, and penetrated deeply into the wet mud beside Chen Mo. The dark red light suddenly extinguished most of it.
But Chen Mo also paid a heavy price.The wound on his left chest was bleeding profusely, and the fire-poison palm was raging crazily in his body, burning his meridians and internal organs. The severe pain almost made him lose consciousness.He staggered back, leaning on the ground with his hatchet, and barely managed not to fall down. Blood spurted from his mouth, and his vision began to blur and spin.
"Little bastard... I want you to die! I want you to die!!" Wang Yan fell to the ground, his right leg and ankle twisted at a weird angle, obviously broken.But he actually used his left hand to support the ground, dragging two almost useless legs, with a face as ferocious as an evil ghost. He grabbed the dagger again in his right hand and desperately crawled towards Chen Mo who was teetering close at hand. The dagger stabbed Chen Mo's lower body randomly!Like crazy!
Chen Mo's vision was blurred, and he could only see a black shadow and a bit of dark red light rolling towards him.He wanted to swing the knife, but the severe pain in his left chest and the weakness caused by blood loss made his arms as heavy as lead, and it became extremely difficult to lift the hatchet.He could only barely take a step back, but his feet were caught by an exposed tree root. He lost his balance and fell backwards!
Seeing Wang Yan's dagger stabbing at random, it was about to pierce his lower abdomen!
“Buzz——!”
At this critical moment, the familiar, slight trembling sound of the strings sounded again!Several rays of silver light that were almost impossible to catch with the naked eye, as if they were alive, were accurately shot at the defenseless Wang Yan who was crawling crazily on the ground!Instead of shooting at his sword-holding hand, he shot at his neck, face and other vital parts!
Although Wang Yan fell into madness, he still had instinctive reactions at the critical moment of life and death.He tilted his head sharply and subconsciously raised his left hand to block.
"Puff puff puff!"
Two of the three silver needles were shot into his raised left arm, and one flew past his neck, leaving a trail of blood.Where the needle hit my left arm, I instantly felt a severe numbness, as if the entire arm was no longer my own and I couldn't lift it.His crawling movements also stagnated.
It's Su Yun!During the fight with Zhao Ming and Li He, she was still distracted enough to deliver these life-saving injections!
But this distraction also cost her.
"Bitch! Seeking death!" Zhao Ming caught the moment when Su Yun was distracted and fired the needle. Regardless of the soreness of his arm, the long sword was filled with fierce force, and regardless of his own weakness, he stabbed Su Yun's throat!It’s a completely lose-lose approach!Li He next to him also took the opportunity to slash Su Yun's waist with his sword!
Su Yun retreated sharply, like catkins floating in the wind, narrowly avoiding the critical point of her throat. However, the clothes at her waist were cut open by Li He's sword, and there was a faint trace of blood seeping out.Her face turned paler, but her eyes were still cold, and the silver light on her fingertips flashed again, forcing Zhao Ming and Li He to draw back their swords to protect themselves, not daring to press too hard.But she was obviously restrained and had no time to pay attention to Chen Mo.
This brief delay was a life-saving straw for Chen Mo.He endured the burning pain in his left chest and the dizziness caused by blood loss. Taking advantage of the moment when Wang Yan's left arm was paralyzed and his movements stagnated, he thrust his right hand on the ground and rolled his body to the side, narrowly avoiding Wang Yan's dagger that lost its aim and pierced into the mud.While rolling, he touched the hatchet he had dropped. Without hesitation, he used his last strength to throw the hatchet in the direction of Wang Yan!
Not cutting or stabbing, but just like throwing a javelin, using the hatchet as a heavy iron rod, hitting Wang Yan!
Wang Yan's left arm was paralyzed, his right ankle was broken, and his left knee was seriously injured, making his movement extremely difficult.Seeing the hatchet coming with the whistling wind, he only had time to barely turn his head.
"Bang!"
The back of the hatchet hit Wang Yan hard on the right temple!The dull crashing sound made people’s teeth sore.Wang Yan's head suddenly tilted, his eyes instantly went blank, and blood and foam overflowed from his mouth. His whole body froze for a moment, and then he fell softly to the ground. The dagger in his hand fell to the ground with a clang, and there was no sound again.Only his body was still twitching slightly unconsciously.
Chen Mo succeeded in the attack, but exhausted his last bit of energy and collapsed to the ground. His vision went black and his ears buzzed. Only the heartbreaking pain from the wound on his left chest and the burning sensation caused by the raging fire and poison in his body told him very clearly that he was still alive, but he was not far from death.
On the other side, Su Yun, Zhao Ming, and Li He's battle group also experienced a moment of stagnation due to the drastic changes here.
Zhao Ming and Li He looked in disbelief at Wang Yan, who was lying on the ground, not knowing whether he was alive or dead, and then at Chen Mo, who was collapsed and bleeding in the distance. Finally, they looked at Su Yun, who was pale but still had silver light shining on her fingertips and was staring at them coldly, with fear finally showing on her face.
Wang Yan, the peak of the fourth level of Qi Refining and the leader among the new disciples of the outer sect, was actually... defeated by a seriously injured handyman in such a way that they almost died together?Although the handyman seemed to be close to death, the result was still difficult for them to accept, and they felt a chill rising from the bottom of their hearts.
This Su Yun has strange movements and vicious hidden weapons.This Chen Mo is brave and unafraid of death, and his methods are ruthless.These two people...
"Senior Brother Zhao...Senior Brother Wang..." Li He's voice trembled, and the hand holding the sword was shaking.
Zhao Ming's face was changing, with fear, unwillingness, greed, and hesitation intertwined in his eyes.Wang Yan fell, and the "opportunity" in the cave seemed to be within easy reach, but Su Yun was still there, and the handyman didn't know whether he was dead or not, and it was not suitable to stay here for a long time... He gritted his teeth suddenly and said sternly: "Let's go! Get out of here first!"
Without even looking at Wang Yan, who didn't know whether he was alive or dead, he turned around and ran towards the direction he came from!Li Heru was granted amnesty and hurriedly followed. The two figures quickly disappeared into the miasma of the dense forest, and they didn't even have the courage to look back.
Su Yun did not pursue.She stood there, panting slightly, looking at the direction in which Zhao and Ming disappeared, then looking down at the bleeding wound on her waist, her brows furrowed almost imperceptibly.Then, she turned around and walked quickly towards Chen Mo.
Chen Mo was lying on the ground, his vision blurred, and he could only see a white, swaying figure approaching him.He tried to raise his hand, but couldn't move a finger.There was a roaring sound in his throat, and he wanted to say something, but only blood foam kept pouring out.
